notes: Both neither and nor are read as rule 35 fusions of a waw with the negative standing in the same clause, since the ASV writes no separate not for either; כֹּל keeps its own any, which rule 35's last sentence directs where the ASV writes a word for each.

strong drink is headed on strong under rule 31's subtraction test — drink alone is any drink, and the ASV writes no bare drink noun here for a word of that class; heading on drink was the competing reading.
